changes.previous: experimental terlan-vm beside an OTP reference runtime
changes.guidance: Use terlc build, run, and test without an Erlang target override.

changes.previous: public Erlang/OTP target spellings were accepted
changes.guidance: Remove the legacy target option; terlan-vm is the native default.

changes.previous: project entry modules required explicit application structure
changes.guidance: Use .terls for executable validation and automation scripts.

changes.previous: reverse-alias function-head patterns could be accepted
changes.current: reverse-alias function-head patterns are rejected consistently
changes.guidance: Preview with terlc migrate pattern-head, then apply with --write.

changes.previous: the experimental VM did not provide the released shard contract
changes.current: fixed-owner multicore execution shards are part of the VM architecture
changes.guidance: Keep actor-owned mutable state shard-local and use capability RPC for unsafe work.
